# CANDIDATE: NAMED_LEVEL_VWAP_REJECTION_WITH_VOLUME_SPIKE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price approaches a predefined named level (prior-day high/low, weekly/monthly pivot) and reclaims VWAP on elevated volume, it often triggers a short-term bounce. This strategy captures that mean-reversion edge by entering longs on the first VWAP reclamation bar with volume spike, avoiding second-test delays that may miss the initial move.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When price is within 0.1% of a named level (prior-day high, prior-day low, weekly pivot, monthly pivot) AND the bar closes above VWAP while opening below VWAP (VWAP reclamation) AND volume > 2× the 20-bar average volume, enter long at the close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop placed just below the named level (chart-stop). Target is 1.5R (risk-reward) or trail using chandelier exit (ATR×2) after achieving 1R profit.  
**Regime filters:** Only active when VIX is between 14-26 and time is after 11:00 EST. Avoid FOMC, CPI, NFP, and major earnings windows (defined in automation/state/news.json).
